entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Reflect on evangelism as you face a family need. This passage invites a thoughtful response: take responsibility, and let your conduct reflect sincere devotion to Jesus Christ.
entries.prayer: Father, in a family need, teach me to take responsibility and follow Your Word faithfully today. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Reflect on hope as you face a moment of uncertainty. This passage invites a thoughtful response: keep your word, and let your conduct reflect sincere devotion to Jesus Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, in a moment of uncertainty, teach me to keep your word and follow Your Word faithfully today. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Reflect on prayer as you face an unexpected change. This passage invites a thoughtful response: forgive sincerely, and let your conduct reflect sincere devotion to Jesus Christ.
topics.prayer: Father, in an unexpected change, teach me to forgive sincerely and follow Your Word faithfully today. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

topics.prayer: Father, in a family need, teach me to take responsibility and follow Your Word faithfully today. Amen.
